title: Parser test bank re-run (RE-USE of the frozen 100-case bank, not new evidence)
status_note: The 100-case parser bank was used before (Experiment 1). It was re-sent unchanged, with the original prompt, schema, validator and grounding rule of controls.parse_control (the grounding rule was applied by re-scoring the saved predictions, scripts/parser_rerun_rescore.py), with no tuning. The frozen Llama 3.1 8B result (79/100) is unchanged; the re-run reproduced it. Strict scores are primary. The frozen prompt states the rule 'Use strength 0.25 for boost, 1.0 for mute, 0.0 for reset/clarify'; gpt-5 and gpt-5-mini broke it on most reset/clarify cases. The post-hoc, format-lenient score ignores only the strength field on reset/clarify replies (run 2, where raw replies were saved).
